description: Thirty hand-authored synthetic multi-participant Russian/English episodes with independent stored expected normalized decisions. These recordings are not live model outputs.
limitations: Replay validates deterministic contracts and safeguards, not semantic extraction quality.
Free-text labels and summaries are illustrative; comparisons cover complete structural claims, exact actor attribution, uncertainty, status transitions and source lineage.
No Telegram traffic, production history, credentials, model invocation or paid API is required.
